svg.aria-label: Figure 1: one API, five verbs. chat: POST /v1/chat/completions, in "What is the capital of France?", out "Paris." (Qwen3.5 on the Bend engine). decide: POST /v1/decide, three choices refund, escalate, ignore, out refund (decision head). see: POST /v1/see, a photo in, a box labelled cup out (D-FINE-N). hear: POST /v1/audio/transcriptions, audio in, "turn on the lights" out (Whisper). speak: POST /v1/audio/speech, "hello" in, speech audio out (Kokoro-82M). Each panel lights in turn.
svg.text: What is the capital of France?
